note: Programmable founder action cards. Buttons route only through the Control Plane service. Event payloads cannot promote mode. TEST creates audit records only and never calls a provider.

actions.title: Run Daily Business Cycle
stateRequirements: inspect all commercial, marketing, learning, content, payment, blocker, job and decision lanes
actions.success: Founder-friendly dry-run summary of progressed, blocked, awaiting external, and founder-required lanes with an audit record and zero external writes.
actions.failureEscalation: Fail closed; escalate unknowns to Alex via Grok_Alex: and ChatGPT review.

actions.title: Review New Leads
actions.success: Non-PII lead refs reviewed; Taylor next steps named; exceptions listed.
actions.failureEscalation: Missing enquiry refs fail closed; route blockers to Alex.

actions.title: Progress Sales Pipeline
actions.success: Sam/Taylor pipeline steps that TEST permissions allow are planned; Closed Won stays blocked.
actions.failureEscalation: Payment or Closed Won attempts escalate to founder inbox; Alex routes blockers.

actions.title: Check Payments
actions.success: Stripe payment truth inspected via dry-run; Sam owns payment_clear; TEST live Closed Won remains blocked.
actions.failureEscalation: Missing Stripe evidence fails closed; named founder unlock stays a separate decision.

actions.title: Progress Paid Clients
actions.success: Payment truth plus consent, Ready, and programme gates named; no live onboarding mutation.
actions.failureEscalation: Missing consent/Ready/founder go-live fail closed and surface as exceptions.

actions.title: Review Onboarding
actions.success: Onboarding refs reviewed against privacy notice + consent titles; screening stays blocked without explicit consent.
actions.failureEscalation: Missing consent blocks screening/Ready; ChatGPT reviews policy titles.

actions.title: Review Coaching Clients
actions.success: Coaching delivery codes reviewed; no Zone C and no health judgement.
actions.failureEscalation: Programme go-live and health/safety stay founder/human gates.

actions.title: Process Weekly Check-ins
actions.success: Check-in codes inspected; Cursor may only plan bounded dry-run open/close records.
actions.failureEscalation: Missed check-ins escalate to Alex; no clinical content on the bus.

actions.title: Review Adherence Risks
actions.success: Adherence codes routed with Grok_Alex: prefix; founder only if a founder gate is involved.
actions.failureEscalation: Unresolved escalation stays blocked; ChatGPT reviews policy, not client health.

actions.title: Generate Next Week’s Marketing
actions.success: Linked dry-run tasks through plan, production, QA, Taylor PASS, ChatGPT PASS, and scheduling check. TEST stops before schedule/publish and names missing exact-final passes.
actions.failureEscalation: Missing dual PASS or TEST schedule permission fails closed; no Metricool write.

actions.title: Review Marketing Performance
actions.success: Performance pointers reviewed; learning may only emit a versioned proposal.
actions.failureEscalation: No live analytics pull; ChatGPT reviews learning proposals.

actions.title: Schedule Approved Content
actions.success: Scheduling check names whether exact-final dual PASS exists. TEST always stops before Metricool schedule/publication.
actions.failureEscalation: Missing exact-final passes or TEST mode block scheduling; do not publish.

actions.title: Check Publication Errors
actions.success: Publication errors listed (missing PASS, checksum/config mismatch). publishEligible stays false unless exact dual PASS.
actions.failureEscalation: Any mismatch fails closed; Taylor and ChatGPT must re-PASS the exact final.

actions.title: Run Controlled-Beta Readiness Audit
actions.success: Readiness gaps listed against TEST registry, named Stripe unlock, consent/Ready/go-live gates. Mode stays TEST unless a trusted registry is injected.
actions.failureEscalation: Event operating_mode is ignored; agents cannot promote mode.

actions.title: Show Founder Decisions
actions.success: Per-item decision packets listed. Approve, Reject, or Request more evidence only — never approve-all.
actions.failureEscalation: Missing packet fails closed; TEST records the decision and never calls a provider.

actions.title: Generate Weekly CEO Brief
actions.success: Non-PII weekly brief of exceptions, gates, and TEST limits. Audit recorded.
actions.failureEscalation: Sensitive keys fail closed; ChatGPT reviews policy titles only.

actions.title: Run Full Business Health Check
actions.success: Whole-company health snapshot: mode, adapters dry-run, exceptions, zero writes. Not a clinical health judgement.
actions.failureEscalation: Unknown adapter or forbidden payload fails closed; escalate to Alex/ChatGPT.
